name: Word rotates
look: One word of a headline keeps changing every two seconds while it is on screen, sliding up out of its mask as the next rises in, underlined in the accent, with a small pause button under the headline (it also pauses under the pointer). In a statement or the close ("Bread for breakfast / lunch / Sunday"), or the hero unless the hero is the word hero, which has its own live word. A comma or full stop after the word stays on its line.
phone: It runs on a phone as on a desktop: the word changes every two seconds, the pause button under the headline.

needs.words: a headline with one word that can take 2 to 4 alternatives (what the product is for)
